title: Properties / keyframes / expressions / text / shape / mask / effects / render queue / output / IO / menu / preferences
notes: CAP033-CAP036 scope. Effect/plugin parameter coverage rides on the 'property' category plus the native side tracked by #17/#18 — there is no separate 'effect' category in the current inventory. 'application' (app.*), 'project'/'item'/'comp'/'layer'/'collection'/'source' belong to the #15 domain. 'system' is included for CAP035 file/IO surface; System.callSystem-class entries keep their own risk.trust and are never auto-executable.
